dn33:1.1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi yena Pāvā nāma Mallānaṃ nagaraṃ tad avasari.
dn33:1.1.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Pāvāyaṃ viharati Cundassa kammāra-puttassa amba-vane. 2.
dn33:1.2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Pāveyyakānaṃ Mallānaṃ Ubbhaṭakaṃ nāma navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acira-kāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvutthaṃ Samaṇena vā Brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussa-bhūtena.
dn33:1.2.2: Assosuṃ kho Pāveyyakā Mallā -‘Bhagavā kira Mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi Pāvaṃ anuppatto Pāvāyaṃ viharati Cundassa kammāra-puttassa amba-vane ti.'
dn33:1.2.3: Atha kho Pāveyyakā Mallā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu , upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Pāveyyakā Mallā Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn33:1.2.4: ‘Idha bhante Pāveyyakānaṃ Mallānaṃ Ubbhaṭakaṃ nāma navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acira-kāritaṃ anajjhāvutthaṃ Samaṇena vā Brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussa-bhūtena.
dn33:1.2.5: Taṃ bhante Bhagavā paṭhamaṃ paribhuñjatu, Bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā
dn33:1.3.1: Atha kho Pāveyyakā Mallā Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā, uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavataṃ abhivādetvā, padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena santhāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā sabba-santhariṃ santhāgāraṃ santharāpetvā, āsanāni paññāpetvā, udaka-maṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā, telappadīpaṃ āropetvā, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
dn33:1.3.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhita kho Pāveyyakā Mallā Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ: ‘Sabba-santhāriṃ
dn33:1.3.4: santhataṃ bhante santhāgāraṃ. āsanāni paññattāni, udaka-maṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telappadīpo āropito,
dn33:1.3.5: yassa dāni bhante Bhagavā kālaṃ maññatīti.' 4.
dn33:1.4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā nivāsetvā patta-cīvaram ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhu-saṃghena yena santhāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami. Upasaṃkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā, santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhima-tthambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
dn33:1.4.2: Bhikkhu-saṃgho pi pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi Bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
dn33:1.4.3: Pāveyyakā pi kho Mallā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu Bhagavataṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
dn33:1.4.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Pāveyyake Malle bahud eva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādepetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi:
dn33:1.4.7: ‘Evam bhante ti' kho Pāveyyakā Mallā Bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu. 5.
dn33:1.5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acira-pakkantesu Mallesu tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhī-bhūtaṃ bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn33:1.5.6: ‘Evam bhante ti' kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn33:1.5.7: Atha kho Bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīha-seyyaṃ kappesi, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhāna-saññaṃ manasi-karitvā. 6.
dn33:1.6.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nātha-putto Pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato hoti.
dn33:1.6.2: Tassa kāla-kiriyāya bhinnā Nigaṇṭhā dvedhika-jātā bhaṇḍana-jātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukha-sattīhi vitudantā virahanti --
dn33:1.6.3: ‘Na tvaṃ imaṃ dhamma-vinayaṃ ājānāsi! Ahaṃ imaṃ dhamma-vina-vinayaṃ ājānāmi! kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhamma-vinayaṃ ājānissasi? Micchā-paṭipanno tvam asi, aham asmi sammā-paṭipanno, sahitam me asahitan te, pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca, aviciṇṇan te viparāvattaṃ, āropito te vādo, niggahīto 'si cara, vāda-ppamokkhāya nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosīti.'
dn33:1.6.4: Vadho yeva kho maññe Nigaṇṭhesu Nātha-puttiyesy vattati.
dn33:1.6.5: Ye pi te nigaṇṭhassa Nāthaputtassa sāvakā gihī odāta-vasanā, te pi Nigaṇṭhesu Nātha-puttiyesu nibbiṇṇa-rūpā paṭivāna-rūpā, yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasama-saṃvattanike asammāsambuddha-ppavedite bhinna-thūpe appaṭisaraṇe. 7.
dn33:1.7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn33:1.7.2: Nigaṇṭho āvuso Nātha-putto Pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato.
dn33:1.7.3: Tassa kāla-kiriyāya bhinnā Nigaṇṭhā dvedhika-jātā . . . pe . . . bhinna-thūpe appaṭisaraṇe.
dn33:1.7.4: Evaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasama-saṃvattanike asammāsambuddha-ppavedite.
dn33:1.7.5: Ayaṃ kho pan' āvuso asmākaṃ Bhagavatā dhammo svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito.
dn33:1.7.6: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṃgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:1.7.7: Katamo c' āvuso asmākaṃ Bhagavatā dhammo svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn33:1.7.8: yattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ?
dn33:1.7.10: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena eko dhammo sammad-akkhāto.
dn33:1.7.11: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 8.
dn33:1.8.4: Ayaṃ kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena eko dhammo sammadakkhāto.
dn33:1.8.5: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 9.
dn33:1.9.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena dve dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:1.9.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:1.9.22: Indriyesu agutta-dvāratā ca bhojane amattaññutā ca. (xx)
dn33:1.9.23: Indriyesu gutta-dvāratā ca bhojane mattaññutā ca.
dn33:1.9.32: (xxix) Diṭṭhi-visuddhi kho pana yathā diṭṭhissa ca padhānaṃ. (xxx)
dn33:1.9.33: Saṃvego ca saṃvejaniyesu ṭhānesu saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānaṃ. (xxxi)
dn33:1.9.34: Asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesu appaṭivānitā ca padhānasmiṃ. (xxxii)
dn33:1.9.37: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena dve dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:1.9.38: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 10.
dn33:1.10.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena tayo dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:1.10.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:1.10.5: Lobho akusala-mūlaṃ, doso akusala-mūlaṃ, moho akusala-mūlaṃ. (ii)
dn33:1.10.7: Alobho kusala-mūlaṃ, adoso kusala-mūlaṃ, amoho kusala-mūlaṃ. (iii)
dn33:1.10.33: Hīnā dhātu, majjhimā dhātu, paṇītā dhātu. (xvi)
dn33:1.10.49: ‘Seyyo 'ham asmīti' vidhā, ‘Sadiso 'ham asmīti' vidhā. ‘Hīno 'ham asmīti' vidhā. (xxiv)
dn33:1.10.51: Atīto addhā, anāgato addhā, paccuppanno addhā. (xxv)
dn33:1.10.53: Sakkāyo anto, sakkāya-samudayo anto, sakkāya-nirodho anto. (xxvi)
dn33:1.10.55: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkha-m-asukhā vedanā. (xxvii)
dn33:1.10.59: Micchatta-niyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsi.
dn33:1.10.61: Atītaṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati. Anāgataṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati ca sampasīdati. Etarahi vā paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati. (xxx)
dn33:1.10.63: Parisuddhakāya-samācāro āvuso Tathāgato, n' atthi Tathāgatassa kāya-duccaritaṃ yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
dn33:1.10.65: Parisuddha-vacī-samācāro āvuso Tathāgato, n' atthi Tathāgatassa vacī-duccaritaṃ yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
dn33:1.10.67: Parisuddhamano-samācāro āvuso Tathāgato, n' atthi Tathāgatassa mano-duccaritaṃ yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
dn33:1.10.70: Rāgo kiñcanaṃ, doso kiñcanaṃ, moho kiñcanaṃ. (xxxii)
dn33:1.10.76: Sanidassana-sappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassana-sappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassanaappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ. (xxxv)
dn33:1.10.80: Sekho puggalo, asekho puggalo, n' eva sekho nāsekho puggalo. (xxxvii)
dn33:1.10.84: Dāna-mayaṃ puñña-kiriya-vatthu, sīla-mayaṃ puñña-kiriya-vatthu, bhāvanā-mayaṃ puñña-kiriya-vatthu. (xxxix)
dn33:1.10.88: Sant' āvuso sattā, paccupaṭṭhita-kāmā, te paccupaṭṭhitesu kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti seyyathā pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
dn33:1.10.90: Sant' āvuso sattā nimmita-kāmā, te nimmetvā nimmetvā kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti seyyathā pi devā Nimmāna-ratī.
dn33:1.10.92: Sant' āvuso sattā para-nimmita-kāmā, te paranimmitesu kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti, seyyathā pi devā Paranimmita-vasavattī.
dn33:1.10.95: Sant' āvuso sattā uppādetvā uppādetvā sukhaṃ viharanti, seyyathā pi devā Brahma-kāyikā.
dn33:1.10.97: Sant' āvuso sattā sukhena abhisannā parisannā paripūrā paripphuṭā,
dn33:1.10.99: ‘Aho sukhaṃ aho sukhan ti,' seyyathā pi devā Ābhassarā.
dn33:1.10.101: Sant' āvuso sattā sukhena abhisannā parisannā paripūrā paripphuṭā,
dn33:1.10.102: tesan taṃ yeva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti , seyyathā pi devā Subha-kiṇṇā.
dn33:1.10.105: Sekhā paññā, asekhā paññā, n' eva sekhā nāsekhā paññā.
dn33:1.10.107: Cintā-mayā paññā, sutamayā paññā, bhāvanā-mayā paññā.
dn33:1.10.121: Savitakko savicāro samādhi, avitakko vicāra-matto samādhi, avitakko avicāro samādhi.
dn33:1.10.123: Suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi. (lii)
dn33:1.10.135: Atītaṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya --
dn33:1.10.137: Anāgataṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya --
dn33:1.10.139: Etarahi vā paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya
dn33:1.10.142: Pubbe-nivāsānussati-ñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattāraṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā. (lix)
dn33:1.10.147: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena tayo dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:1.10.148: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 11.
dn33:1.11.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena cattāro dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:1.11.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn33:1.11.5: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ,
dn33:1.11.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ. (ii)
dn33:1.11.10: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn33:1.11.11: Uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn33:1.11.12: Anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn33:1.11.13: Uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyo -bhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. (iii)
dn33:1.11.20: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhama-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.21: Vitakka- vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ dutiya-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.22: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti -- ‘Upekhako satimā sukha-vihārī ti' tatiya-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.23: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassa-domanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkha-m-asukhaṃ upekhā-satipārisuddhiṃ catuttha-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. (v)
dn33:1.11.25: Atth' āvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā diṭṭhadhamma-sukhavihārāya saṃvattati.
dn33:1.11.26: Atth' āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā ñāṇa-dassana-paṭilābhāyā saṃvattati. Atth' āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sati-sampajaññāya saṃvattati.
dn33:1.11.29: Katam' āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā diṭṭhadhamma-sukha-vihārāya saṃvattati?
dn33:1.11.30: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi paṭhamajjhānaṃ . . .
dn33:1.11.33: Ayaṃ āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā diṭṭhadhamma-sukha-vihārāya saṃvattati.
dn33:1.11.34: Katamā ca āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā ñāṇa-dassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati?
dn33:1.11.35: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasi-karoti, divā-saññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā,
dn33:1.11.36: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
dn33:1.11.37: Ayaṃ āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā ñāṇa-dassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
dn33:1.11.38: Katamā ca āvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā sati-sampajaññāya saṃvattati?
dn33:1.11.39: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
dn33:1.11.40: viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
dn33:1.11.41: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
dn33:1.11.42: Ayaṃ āvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā sati-sampajaññāya saṃvattati.
dn33:1.11.43: Katamā ca āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati?
dn33:1.11.44: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu pañcas' upādāna-kkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati --
dn33:1.11.45: ‘Iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo,
dn33:1.11.49: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti.'
dn33:1.11.50: Ayaṃ āvuso samādhi-bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulī-katā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati. (vi)
dn33:1.11.52: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu mettā sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettā-sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn33:1.11.55: sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhā sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati. (vii)
dn33:1.11.57: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpa-saññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭigha-saññānaṃ atthagamā nānatta-saññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘Ananto ākāso ti' ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.58: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti' viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.59: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘Natthi kiñcīti' ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:1.11.60: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. (viii)
dn33:1.11.62: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu saṃkhāy' ekaṃ paṭisevati, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ adhivāseti, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ parivajjeti, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ vinodeti. (ix)
dn33:1.11.64: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena cīvarena, itarītara-cīvara-santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇa-vādī, na ca cīvara-hetu anesanaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca cīvaraṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca cīvaraṃ agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnava-dassāvī nissaraṇa-pañño paribhuñjati, tāya ca pana itarītara-cīvarasantuṭṭhiyā n' ev' attān-ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
dn33:1.11.65: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno patissato, yaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariya-vaṃse ṭhito.
dn33:1.11.66: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭo hoti itarītarena piṇḍapātena, itarītara-piṇḍapāta-santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇa-vādī, na ca piṇḍapāta-hetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ na paritassati laddhā ca piṇḍapātam agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇa-pañño paribhuñjati, tāya ca pana itarītara-piṇḍapāta-santuṭṭhiyā n' eva attān-ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
dn33:1.11.67: Yo hi tattha dakkho hoti analaso samapajāno patissato, ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariya-vaṃse ṭhito.
dn33:1.11.68: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭo hoti itarītarena senāsanena, itarītarasenāsana- santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇa-vādī, na ca senāsana-hetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca senāsanaṃ na paritassati laddhā ca senāsanaṃ agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnava-dassāvī nissaraṇa-pañño paribhuñjati, tāya ca pana itarītara-senāsana-santuṭṭhiyā n' eva attān-ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
dn33:1.11.69: Yo hi tattha dakkho hoti analaso sampajāno patissato, ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariya-vaṃse ṭhito.
dn33:1.11.70: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu pahānārāmo hoti pahāna-rato, bhāvanārāmo hoti bhāvanā-rato, tāya ca pana pahānārāmatāya pahāna-ratiyā bhāvanārāmatāya bhāvanā-ratiyā n' eva attān-ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
dn33:1.11.71: Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno patissato, ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariya-vaṃse ṭhito. (x)
dn33:1.11.75: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimitta-ggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī, yatvādhikaraṇam
dn33:1.11.76: etaṃ cakkhindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā-domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāy'assaveyyuṃ , tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhindriyaṃ, cakkhindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn33:1.11.81: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī, yatvādhikaraṇaṃ
dn33:1.11.82: etaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāya-ssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn33:1.11.85: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāma-vitakkaṃ nādhivaseti pajahati vinodeti byantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti,
dn33:1.11.88: uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivaseti pajahati vinodeti byantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
dn33:1.11.91: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu sati-sambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti viveka-nissitaṃ virāga-nissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossagga-pariṇāmiṃ;
dn33:1.11.97: upekhā-sambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāga-nissitaṃ nirodha-nissitaṃ vossagga-pariṇāmiṃ.
dn33:1.11.100: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhaddakaṃ samādhi-nimittaṃ anurakkhati aṭṭhika-saññaṃ puḷavaka-saññaṃ vinīlaka-saññaṃ vicchiddaka-saññaṃ uddhumātaka-saññaṃ.
dn33:1.11.103: Dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, paricchede ñāṇaṃ, sammuti-ñāṇaṃ.
dn33:1.11.105: Dukkhe ñāṇaṃ , samudaye ñāṇaṃ, nirodhe ñāṇaṃ, magge ñāṇaṃ. (xiii)
dn33:1.11.109: Idh' āvuso ariyasāvako Buddhe avecca-ppasādena samannāgato hoti --
dn33:1.11.110: ‘Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho vijjā-caraṇasampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā devā-manussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā ti.'
dn33:1.11.112: ‘Svākkhāto Bhagavatā Dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehi-passiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.'
dn33:1.11.114: ‘Supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakaSaṃgho, uju-paṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, ñāyapaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, sāmīci-paṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisa-yugāni, aṭṭha purisa-puggalā, eso Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjali-kāraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puñña-kkhettaṃ lokassāti.'
dn33:1.11.115: Ariya-kantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhi-saṃvattanikehi. (xv)
dn33:1.11.121: Kabaliṅkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, mano-sañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ. (xviii)
dn33:1.11.123: Rūpūpāyaṃ vā āvuso viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati, rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpavesanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.
dn33:1.11.126: vā āvuso viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati, saṃkhārārammaṇaṃ saṃkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpavesanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati. (xix)
dn33:1.11.128: Chandāgatiṃ gacchati, dosāgatiṃ gacchati, mohāgatiṃ gacchati, bhayāgatiṃ gacchati. (xx)
dn33:1.11.130: Cīvara-hetu vā āvuso bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
dn33:1.11.131: Piṇḍapātahetu vā āvuso bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
dn33:1.11.132: Senāsana-hetu vā āvuso bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
dn33:1.11.133: Iti- bhavābhava-hetu vā āvuso bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati. (xxi)
dn33:1.11.135: Dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
dn33:1.11.137: Akkhamā paṭipadā, khamā paṭipadā, damā paṭipadā, samā paṭipadā. (xxiii)
dn33:1.11.139: Anabhijjhā dhammapadaṃ, avyāpādo dhamma-padaṃ, sammā-sati dhammapadaṃ, sammā-samādhi dhamma-padaṃ. (xxiv)
dn33:1.11.141: Atth' āvuso dhamma-samādānaṃ paccuppannaṃ dukkhañ c' eva āyatiñ ca dukkha-vipākaṃ.
dn33:1.11.142: Atth' āvuso dhamma-samādānaṃ paccuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ āyatiñ ca sukha-vipākam.
dn33:1.11.143: Atth' āvuso dhamma-samādānaṃ paccuppannaṃ sukhaṃ āyatiñ ca dukkha-vipākaṃ.
dn33:1.11.144: Atth' āvuso dhamma-samādānaṃ paccuppannaṃ sukhañ c' eva āyatiñ ca sukha-vipākaṃ. (xxv)
dn33:1.11.152: Ekaṃsa-vyākaraṇīyo pañho, vibhajja-vyākaraṇīyo pañho, paṭipucchā-vyākaraṇīyo pañho, ṭhapanīyo pañho. (xxix)
dn33:1.11.157: Atth' āvuso kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇha-asukka-vipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. (xxx)
dn33:1.11.170: Abhijjhā kāya-gantho, vyāpādo kāya-gantho, sīlabbata-parāmāso kāya-gantho, idaṃ-saccābhiniveso kāya-gantho. (xxxv)
dn33:1.11.176: Idh' āvuso ekacco asampajāno c' eva mātu kucchiyam okkamati, asampajāno mātu kucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati. Ayaṃ paṭhamā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn33:1.11.177: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso idh' ekacco sampajāno hi kho mātu kucchismim okkamati, asampajāno mātu-kucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati. Ayaṃ dutiyā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn33:1.11.178: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso idh' ekacco sampajāno mātu kucchismim okkamati, sampajāno mātu kucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati. Ayaṃ tatiyā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn33:1.11.179: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso idh' ekacco sampajāno c' eva mātu kucchismim okkamati, sampajāno mātu kucchismiṃ ṭhāti, sampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati. Ayaṃ catutthā gabbhāvakkanti. (xxxviii)
dn33:1.11.181: Atth' āvuso attabhāva-paṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāva-paṭilābhe attasaṃcetanā yeva kamati no para-saṃcetanā.
dn33:1.11.182: Atth' āvuso attabhāva-paṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāva-paṭilābhe para-saṃcetanā yeva kamati no atta-saṃcetanā.
dn33:1.11.183: Atth' āvuso attabhāva-paṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāva-paṭilābhe atta-saṃcetanā c' eva kamati para-saṃcetanā ca.
dn33:1.11.184: Atth' āvuso attabhāva-paṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāva-paṭilābhe n' eva atta saṃcetanā kamati no para-saṃcetanā. (xxxix)
dn33:1.11.186: Atth' āvuso dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
dn33:1.11.187: Atth' āvuso dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
dn33:1.11.188: Atth' āvuso dakkhiṇā n' eva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
dn33:1.11.189: Atth' āvuso dakkhiṇā dāyakato c' eva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca. (xl)
dn33:1.11.193: Musā-vādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo. (xlii)
dn33:1.11.195: Musā-vādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī.
dn33:1.11.197: Adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, assute suta-vāditā, amute muta-vāditā, aviññāte viññāta-vāditā. (xliv)
dn33:1.11.199: Adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, assute assuta-vāditā, amute amuta-vāditā, aviññāte aviññāta-vāditā. (xlv)
dn33:1.11.201: Diṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, sute assuta-vāditā, mute amuta-vāditā, viññāte aviññāta-vāditā. (xlvi)
dn33:1.11.203: Diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute suta-vāditā, mute muta-vāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā. (xlvii)
dn33:1.11.205: Idh' āvuso ekacco puggalo attan-tapo hoti atta-paritāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
dn33:1.11.206: Idh' āvuso ekacco puggalo paran-tapo hoti para-paritāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
dn33:1.11.207: Idh' āvuso ekacco puggalo attantapo ca hoti atta-paritāpanānuyogam anuyutto, parantapo ca para-paritāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
dn33:1.11.208: Idh' āvuso ekacca puggalo n' eva attan-tapo hoti na attaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto na paran-tapo na paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
dn33:1.11.209: So anattan-tapo aparantapo diṭṭhe va dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sīti-bhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahma-bhūtena attanā viharati.
dn33:1.11.211: Idh' āvuso ekacco puggalo atta-hitāya paṭipanno hoti no para-hitāya. Idha pan'
dn33:1.11.212: āvuso ekacco puggalo para-hitāya paṭipanno hoti no atta-hitāya.
dn33:1.11.213: Idh' āvuso ekacco puggalo n' eva atta-hitāya paṭipanno hoti no para-hitāya. Idha pan'
dn33:1.11.214: āvuso ekacco puggalo atta-hitāya c' eva paṭipanno hoti para-hitāya ca.
dn33:1.11.216: Tamo tama-parāyano, tamo joti-parāyano, joti tama-parāyano, joti joti-parāyano. (l)
dn33:1.11.219: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena cattāro dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:1.11.220: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 7
dn33:2.1.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena pañca dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:2.1.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:2.1.9: Cakkhu-viññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piya-rūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
dn33:2.1.13: kāya-viññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piya-rūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. (iv)
dn33:2.1.25: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī, musā-vādā veramaṇī, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī. (x)
dn33:2.1.27: Abhabbo āvuso khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃādātuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajāna-musā bhāsituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhi-kārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ, seyyathā pi pubbe agāriya-bhūto. (xi)
dn33:2.1.30: N' āvuso sattā ñāti-vyasana-hetu vā bhoga-vyasana-hetu vā roga-vyasana-hetu vā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjanti. Sīlavyasana-
dn33:2.1.31: hetu vā āvuso sattā diṭṭhi-vyasana-hetu vā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā . . . pe . . . nirayaṃ upapajjanti. (xii)
dn33:2.1.33: Ñāti-sampadā, bhoga-sampadā, ārogya-sampadā, sīla-sampadā, diṭṭhi-sampadā. N' āvuso sattā ñāti-sampadā-hetu vā bhoga-sampadā-hetu vā ārogyasampadā-hetu
dn33:2.1.34: vā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
dn33:2.1.35: Sīla-sampadā-hetu vā āvuso sattā diṭṭhi-sampadā-hetu vā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. (xiii)
dn33:2.1.37: Idh' āvuso dussīlo sīla-vipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhoga-jāniṃ nigacchati.
dn33:2.1.39: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso dussīlassa vipannassa pāpako kitti-saddo abbhuggacchati.
dn33:2.1.41: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso dussīlo sīla-vipanno yaṃ yad eva parisaṃ upasaṃkamati, yadi khattiya-parisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇa-parisaṃ yadi gahapati-parisaṃ yadi samaṇa-parisaṃ, avisārado upasaṃkamati maṅko-bhūto.
dn33:2.1.43: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso dussīlo sīla-vipanno sammūḷho kālaṃ kāroti.
dn33:2.1.45: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati.
dn33:2.1.48: Idh' āvuso sīlavā sīla-sampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhoga-kkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.
dn33:2.1.50: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso sīlavato sīla-sampannassa kalyāṇo kitti-saddo abbhuggacchati.
dn33:2.1.52: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso sīlavā sīla-sampanno yaṃ yad eva parisaṃ upasaṃkamati, yadi khattiya-parisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇa -parisaṃ yadi gahapati-parisaṃ yadi samaṇa-parisaṃ, visārado upasaṃkamati amaṅku-bhūto.
dn33:2.1.54: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso sīlavā sīla-sampanno asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
dn33:2.1.56: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso sīlavā sīla-sampanno kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati.
dn33:2.1.58: Codakena āvuso bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu-kāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo:-‘Kālena
dn33:2.1.64: Codakena āvuso bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu-kāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo. (xvi)
dn33:2.1.66: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bhodhiṃ:--
dn33:2.1.67: ‘Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā ti.'
dn33:2.1.68: Appābādho hoti appātaṅko sama-vepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhāna-kkhamāya.
dn33:2.1.69: Asatho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā Satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
dn33:2.1.70: Āraddha-viriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷha-parakkamo anikkhitta-dhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
dn33:2.1.71: Paññavā hoti uḍayattha-gāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā-dukkha-kkhaya-gāminiyā. (xvii)
dn33:2.1.75: Antarā-parinibbāyī, upahacca-parinibbāyī, asaṃkhāra-parinibbāyī, sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsoto Akaniṭṭha-gāmī. (xix)
dn33:2.1.77: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati.
dn33:2.1.78: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo.
dn33:2.1.79: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu Dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati . . . pe . . .
dn33:2.1.82: sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhata-citto khila-jāto.
dn33:2.1.83: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhata-citto khila-jāto, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Ayaṃ pañcamo ceto-khilo. (xx)
dn33:2.1.85: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu kāme avigata-rāgo hoti avigata-chando avigata-pemo avigata-pipāso avigata-pariḷāho avigata-taṇho.
dn33:2.1.86: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu kāme avigata-rāgo hoti avigata-chando avigata-pemo avigata-pipāso avigata-pariḷāho avigata-taṇho, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
dn33:2.1.89: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu kāye avigata-rāgo hoti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dutiyo cetaso vinibandho.
dn33:2.1.91: ayaṃ tatiyo cetaso vinibandho. Yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyya-sukhaṃ phassa-sukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati.
dn33:2.1.92: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu aññataraṃ deva-nikāyaṃ panidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati -- ‘Iminā 'haṃ vatena vā sīlena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā ti.'
dn33:2.1.93: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu aññataraṃ deva-nikāyaṃ panidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati -- ‘Iminā 'haṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo bhavissāmi devaññataro vā ti,' tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa . . . pe . . .
dn33:2.1.102: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno kāme manasikaroto kāmesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.103: nekkhammaṃ kho pan' assa manasikaroto nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.104: tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ kāmehi,
dn33:2.1.105: ye ca kāma-paccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
dn33:2.1.107: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno vyāpādaṃ manasikaroto vyāpāde cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.108: avyāpādaṃ kho pan' assa manasikaroto avyāpāde cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.109: tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vyāpādena,
dn33:2.1.110: ye ca vyāpāda-paccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
dn33:2.1.112: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno vihesaṃ manasikaroto vihesāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.113: avihesaṃ kho pan' assa manasikaroto avihesāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.114: tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vihesāya,
dn33:2.1.115: ye ca vihesā-paccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
dn33:2.1.117: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno rūpaṃ manasikaroto rūpesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.118: arūpaṃ kho pan' assa manasikaroto arūpesu cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.119: tassa tam cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitam suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi,
dn33:2.1.120: ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
dn33:2.1.122: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno sakkāyaṃ manasikaroto sakkāye cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.123: sakkāya-nirodhaṃ kho pan' assa manasikaroto sakkāya-nirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
dn33:2.1.124: tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ sakkāyena,
dn33:2.1.125: ye ca sakkāya-paccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
dn33:2.1.128: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī.
dn33:2.1.129: Yathā yathā āvuso bhikkhuno Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī, tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme attha-paṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca.
dn33:2.1.130: Tassa attha-paṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha-kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
dn33:2.1.132: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno na h' eva kho Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī, api ca kho yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti.
dn33:2.1.136: Yathā yathā āvuso bhikkhu yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhamma-paṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhamma-paṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha -kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ dutiyaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ. Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno na h' eva kho Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī, na pi yathāsutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, api ca kho yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. Yathā yathā 'vuso bhikkhu yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme attha-paṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhamma-paṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhamma-paṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha-kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ tatiyaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ. Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno na h' eva kho Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī, na pi yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vittārena paresaṃ deseti, na pi yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, api ca kho yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasā 'nupekkhati. Yathā yathā āvuso bhikkhu yathā-sutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasā 'nupekkhati, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme attha paṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhamma-paṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhamma-paṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha-kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ catutthaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ. Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno na h' eva kho Satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniko sabrahmacārī, na pi yathāsutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, na pi yathā-sutaṃ yathā-pariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, na pi yathā-sutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasā 'nupekkhati, api ca kho assa aññataraṃ samādhinimittaṃ suggahītaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ supadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya. Yathā yathā āvuso bhikkhuno aññataraṃ samādhi-nimittaṃ suggahītaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ supadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme attha-paṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca.
dn33:2.1.137: Tassa attha-paṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha-kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
dn33:2.1.140: Anicca-saññā, anicce dukkha-saññā, dukkhe anatta-saññā, pahāna-saññā, virāga-saññā.
dn33:2.1.141: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena pañca dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:2.1.142: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 2.
dn33:2.2.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena cha dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:2.2.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:2.2.5: Cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ. (ii)
dn33:2.2.7: Rūpāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ , dhammāyatanaṃ. (iii)
dn33:2.2.9: Cakkhu-viññāṇaṃ, sota-viññāṇaṃ, ghāna-viññāṇaṃ, jivhā-viññāṇaṃ, kāya-viññāṇaṃ, mano-viññāṇaṃ. (iv)
dn33:2.2.11: Cakkhu-samphasso, sota-samphasso, ghāna-samphasso, jivhā-samphasso, kāya-samphasso, mano-samphasso. (v)
dn33:2.2.13: vedanā-kāyā. Cakkhu samphassajā vedanā, sota-samphassajā vedanā, ghāna-samphassajā vedanā, jivhāsamphassajā vedanā, kāya-samphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā. (vi)
dn33:2.2.15: Rūpa-saññā, sadda-saññā, gandha-saññā , rasa-saññā, phoṭṭhabba-saññā, dhamma-saññā. (vii)
dn33:2.2.17: Rūpa-sañcetanā, sadda-sañcetanā, gandha-sañcetanā, rasa-sañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhamma-sañcetanā. (viii)
dn33:2.2.19: Rūpa-taṇhā, sadda-taṇhā, gandha-taṇhā, rasa-taṇhā, phoṭṭhabba-taṇhā, dhammataṇhā. (ix)
dn33:2.2.21: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu Satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, Dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, Saṃghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya agāravo viharati appatisso, appamāde agāravo viharati appatisso, paṭisanthāre agāravo viharati appatisso. (x)
dn33:2.2.23: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu Satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso, Dhamme sagāravo viharati sappatisso, Saṃghe sagāravo viharati sappatisso, sikkhāya sagāravo viharati sappatisso, appamāde sagāravo viharati sappatisso, paṭisanthāre sagāravo viharati sappatisso. (xi)
dn33:2.2.25: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassa-ṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.
dn33:2.2.30: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassa-ṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati. (xii)
dn33:2.2.32: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā domanassa-ṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati . . . pe . . .
dn33:2.2.33: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya domanassa-ṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati. (xiii)
dn33:2.2.35: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā upekhaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati. Sotena saddhaṃ sutvā . . . ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā . . . jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā . . . kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā . . .
dn33:2.2.36: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya upekha-ṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati. (xiv)
dn33:2.2.38: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno mettaṃ kāya-kammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvī c' eva raho ca,
dn33:2.2.39: ayam pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
dn33:2.2.40: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno mettaṃ vacī-kammaṃ . . . mettaṃ mano-kammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvī c' eva raho ca,
dn33:2.2.41: ayam pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piya-karaṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekī-bhāvāya saṃvattati.
dn33:2.2.44: āvuso bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso patta-pariyāpanna-mattam pi, tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhatta-bhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇa-bhogī,
dn33:2.2.45: ayam pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
dn33:2.2.46: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni, tathārūpesu sīlesu sīla-sāmañña-gato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvī c' eva raho ca,
dn33:2.2.47: ayam pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piya-karaṇo garu-karaṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekī-bhāvāya saṃvattati.
dn33:2.2.48: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu yā 'yaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkhakkhayāya tathā-rūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhi-sāmañña-gato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvī c' eva raho ca,
dn33:2.2.49: ayam pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piya-karaṇo garu-karaṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekī-bhāvāya saṃvattati. (xv)
dn33:2.2.51: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī.
dn33:2.2.52: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī, so Satthari pi agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Dhamme pi agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Saṃghe pi agāravo viharati appaṭisso, sikkhāya pi na paripūra-kārī hoti.
dn33:2.2.53: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu Satthari agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Dhamme agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Saṃghe agāravo viharati appaṭisso, sikkhāya na paripūra-kārī, so Saṃghe vivādaṃ janeti. Yo so hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujana-asukhāya bahu-janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:2.2.54: Evarūpañ ce tumhe āvuso vivāda-mūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha, tatra tumhe āvuso tass' eva pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha.
dn33:2.2.55: Evarūpañ ce tumhe āvuso vivāda-mūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha, tatra tumhe āvuso tass' eva pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha.
dn33:2.2.56: Evam etassa pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa pahānaṃ hoti, evam etassa pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti.
dn33:2.2.57: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu makkhī hoti paḷāsī . . .
dn33:2.2.61: sandiṭṭhi-parāmāsī hoti ādhāna-gāhī duppaṭinissaggi. Yo so āvuso bhikkhu sandiṭṭhi-parāmāsī hoti ādhāna-gāhī duppaṭinissaggi, so Satthari pi agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Dhamme pi agāravo viharati appaṭisso, Saṃghe . . . pe . . .
dn33:2.2.63: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu Satthari agāravo viharati appaṭisso , Dhamme . . . Saṅghe . . . sikkhāya na paripūrā-kārī, so Saṃghe vivādaṃ janeti. Yo so hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujanaasukhāya bahujanassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn33:2.2.64: Evarūpañ ce tumhe āvuso vivāda-mūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha, tatra tumhe āvuso tass' eva pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha.
dn33:2.2.65: Evarūpañ ce tumhe āvuso vivāda-mūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha, tatra tumhe āvuso tass' eva pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha.
dn33:2.2.66: Evam etassa pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa pahānaṃ hoti, evam etassa pāpakassa vivāda-mūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti. (xvi)
dn33:2.2.68: Paṭhavī-dhātu, āpo-dhātu, tejodhātu, vāyo-dhātu, ākāsa-dhātu, viññāṇa-dhātu. (xvii)
dn33:2.2.71: ‘Mettā hi kho me ceto-vimutti bhāvitā bahulī-katā yāni-katā vatthu-katā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
dn33:2.2.72: Atha ca pana me vyāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.'
dn33:2.2.73: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.74: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ mettāya ceto-vimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulī-katāya yāni-katāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
dn33:2.2.75: atha ca pan' assa vyāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, n' etam ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.76: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso vyāpādassa, yadidaṃ mettā ceto-vimutti.
dn33:2.2.77: Idha pana āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya --
dn33:2.2.78: ‘Karuṇā hi kho me ceto-vimutti bhāvitā bahulī-katā yāni-katā vatthu-katā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
dn33:2.2.79: Atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.'
dn33:2.2.80: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.81: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulī-katāya yāni-katāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
dn33:2.2.82: atha ca pan' assa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.83: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso vihesāya, yadidaṃ karuṇā ceto-vimutti.
dn33:2.2.84: Idha pan' āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya --
dn33:2.2.85: ‘Muditā hi kho me ceto-vimutti bhāvitā bahulī-katā yāni-katā vatthu-katā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
dn33:2.2.86: Atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.'
dn33:2.2.87: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.88: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulī-katāya yāni-katāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
dn33:2.2.89: atha ca pan' assa arati cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.90: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso aratiyā, yadidaṃ muditā ceto-vimutti.
dn33:2.2.91: Idha pan' āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya --
dn33:2.2.92: ‘Upekhā hi kho me ceto-vimutti bhāvitā bahulī-katā yāni-katā vatthu-katā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
dn33:2.2.93: Atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.'
dn33:2.2.94: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.95: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ upekhāya ceto-vimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulī-katāya yāni-katāya vatthu-katāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
dn33:2.2.96: atha ca pan' assa rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.97: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso rāgassa, yadidaṃ upekhā ceto-vimutti.
dn33:2.2.98: Idha pan' āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya --
dn33:2.2.99: ‘Animittā hi kho me ceto-vimutti bhāvitā bahulī-katā yāni-katā vatthu-katā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
dn33:2.2.100: Atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotīti.'
dn33:2.2.101: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.102: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ animmitāya ceto-vimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulī-katāya yāni-katāya vatthu-katāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
dn33:2.2.103: atha ca pan' assa nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.104: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso sabba-nimittānaṃ, yadidaṃ animittā ceto-vimutti.
dn33:2.2.105: Idha pan' āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya --
dn33:2.2.106: "‘Asmīti" kho me vighātaṃ, "ayam aham asmīti" na samanupassāmi.
dn33:2.2.107: Atha ca pana me vicikicchā-kathaṅkathā-sallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti.'
dn33:2.2.108: So ‘Mā h' evan ti' 'ssa vacanīyo, ‘Mā 'yasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.'
dn33:2.2.109: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso. Yaṃ ‘asmīti' vighāte ‘ayam aham asmīti' asamanupassato,
dn33:2.2.110: atha ca pan' assa vicikicchā-kathaṅkathā-sallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn33:2.2.111: Nissaraṇaṃ h' etaṃ āvuso vicikicchā-kathaṅkathā-sallassa, yadidam ‘asmīti' māna-samugghāto. (xviii)
dn33:2.2.113: Dassanānuttariyaṃ, savanānuttariyaṃ, lābhānuttariyaṃ, sikkhānuttariyaṃ, pāricariyānuttariyaṃ, anussutānuttariyaṃ. (xix)
dn33:2.2.115: Buddhānussati, Dhammānussati, Saṃghānussati, sīlānussati, cāgānussati, devatānussati. (xx)
dn33:2.2.117: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekhako viharati sato sampajāno;
dn33:2.2.118: sotena saddaṃ sutvā . . . ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā . . . jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā . . . kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā . . .
dn33:2.2.119: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekhako viharati sato sampajāno.
dn33:2.2.121: Idh' āvuso ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati.
dn33:2.2.122: Idh' āvuso ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati.
dn33:2.2.123: Idh' āvuso ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.
dn33:2.2.124: Idha pan' āvuso ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati.
dn33:2.2.125: Idh' āvuso ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati.
dn33:2.2.126: Idha pan' āvuso ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati. (xxii)
dn33:2.2.128: Anicca-saññā, anicce dukkha-saññā, dukkhe anatta saññā, pahāna-saññā, virāga-saññā, nirodha-saññā.
dn33:2.2.129: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena cha dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:2.2.130: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 3.
dn33:2.3.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena satta dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:2.3.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:2.3.5: Saddhā-dhanaṃ, sīla-dhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappa-dhanaṃ, suta-dhanaṃ, cāga-dhanaṃ, paññā -dhanaṃ. (ii)
dn33:2.3.7: Sati-sambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicaya-sambojjhaṅgo, viriya-sambojjhaṅgo, pīti-sambojjhaṅgo, passaddhi-sambojjhaṅgo, samādhi-sambojjhaṅgo, upekhā-sambojjhaṅgo. (iii)
dn33:2.3.9: Sammā-diṭṭhi, sammāsaṃkappo, sammā-vācā, sammā-kammanto, sammā-ājīvo, sammā-vāyāmo, sammā-sati. (iv)
dn33:2.3.11: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu asaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭha-ssati hoti, duppañño hoti. (v)
dn33:2.3.13: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, upaṭṭhita-sati hoti, paññavā hoti. (vi)
dn33:2.3.15: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti, atthaññū ca, attaññū ca, mattaññū ca, kālaññū ca, parisaññū ca, puggalaññū ca. (vii)
dn33:2.3.17: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu sikkhā-samādāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca sikkhā-samādāne avigata-pemo.
dn33:2.3.18: Dhamma-nisantiyā tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca dhamma-nisantiyā avigata-pemo.
dn33:2.3.19: Icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca icchā-vinaye avigatapemo.
dn33:2.3.20: Paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca paṭisallāne avigata-pemo.
dn33:2.3.21: Viriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca viriyārambhe avigata-pemo.
dn33:2.3.22: Sati-nepakke tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca sati-nepakke avigatapemo.
dn33:2.3.23: Diṭṭhi-paṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca diṭṭhi-paṭivedhe avigata-pemo. (viii)
dn33:2.3.25: Anicca-saññā, anatta-saññā, asubhasaññā, ādīnava-saññā, pahāna-saññā, virāga-saññā, nirodhasaññā. (ix)
dn33:2.3.27: Saddhā-balaṃ, viriya-balaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappa-balaṃ, sati-balaṃ, samādhi-balaṃ, paññābalaṃ. (x)
dn33:2.3.29: Sant' āvuso sattā nānattakāyā nānatta-saññino, seyyathā pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
dn33:2.3.31: Sant' āvuso sattā nānatta-kāyā ekatta-saññino seyyathā pi devā Brahma-kāyikā pathamābhinibbattā.
dn33:2.3.33: Sant' āvuso sattā ekattakāyā nānatta-saññino, seyyathā pi devā Ābhassarā.
dn33:2.3.35: Sant' āvuso sattā ekatta-kāyā ekatta-saññino, seyyathā pi devā Subhakiṇhā.
dn33:2.3.37: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso rūpa-saññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭigha-saññānaṃ atthagamā, nānatta-saññānaṃ amanasikārā, ‘Ananto ākāso ti' ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:2.3.39: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samaṭikkamma ‘Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti' viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:2.3.41: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘N' atthi kiñcīti' ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā.
dn33:2.3.44: Ubhato bhāga-vimutto, paññā-vimutto, kāya-sakkhī, diṭṭhi-ppatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī. (xii)
dn33:2.3.46: Kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, mānānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo, avijjānusayo. (xiii)
dn33:2.3.48: Anunaya-saṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhi-saṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchā-saṃyojanaṃ, māna-saṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāga-saṃyojanaṃ, avijjā-saṃyojanaṃ. (xiv)
dn33:2.3.49: Satta adhikarana-samathā uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya.
dn33:2.3.50: Sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sati-vinayo dātabbo, amūḷha-vinayo dātabbo, patiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassa-pāpiyyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.
dn33:2.3.51: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena satta dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:2.3.52: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 3. .

dn33:3.1.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:3.1.5: Micchā-diṭṭhi, micchā-saṃkappo, micchā-vācā, micchā-kammanto, micchā-ājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchā-sati, micchā-samādhi. (ii)
dn33:3.1.9: Sotāpanno sotāpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmi-phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno. (iv)
dn33:3.1.11: Idh' āvuso bhikkhunā kammaṃ kattabbaṃ hoti.
dn33:3.1.13: ‘Kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.14: So nipajjati, na viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
dn33:3.1.16: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti.
dn33:3.1.18: -‘Ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.19: So nipajjati, na viriyaṃ ārabhati . . . pe . . .
dn33:3.1.21: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti.
dn33:3.1.23: ‘Maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.26: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti.
dn33:3.1.28: ‘Ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.31: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
dn33:3.1.33: ‘Ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ va nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo kilanto akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.36: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa va bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
dn33:3.1.38: ‘Ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño māsācitaṃ maññe, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.41: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho.
dn33:3.1.47: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti acira-vuṭṭhito gelaññā.
dn33:3.1.49: ‘Ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito acira-vuṭṭhito gelaññā, tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmīti.'
dn33:3.1.50: So nipajjati, na viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
dn33:3.1.53: Idh' āvuso bhikkhunā kammaṃ kattabbaṃ hoti.
dn33:3.1.55: ‘Kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontena na sukaraṃ Buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.'
dn33:3.1.56: So viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
dn33:3.1.58: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti.

dn33:3.1.81: ‘Ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo balavā kammañño, handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi . . . pe . . .'

dn33:3.1.91: ‘Ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito acira-vuṭṭhito gelaññā, ṭhānam kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ me ābādho paccudāvatteyya, handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.'
dn33:3.1.92: So viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
dn33:3.1.95: Āsajja dānaṃ deti. Bhayā dānaṃ deti. ‘Adāsi me' ti dānaṃ deti. ‘Dassati me ti' dānaṃ deti. ‘Sāhu dānan ti' dānaṃ deti. ‘Ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, narahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātun ti' dānaṃ deti. ‘Idaṃ me dānaṃ dadato kalyāṇo kitti-saddo abbhuggacchatīti' dānaṃ deti.
dn33:3.1.98: Idh' āvuso ekacco dānaṃ deti Samaṇassa vā Brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālā-gandha-vilepanaṃ seyyāvasatha-padīpeyyaṃ.
dn33:3.1.100: So passati khattiyamahāsālaṃ vā brāhmaṇa-mahāsālaṃ vā gahapati-mahāsālaṃ vā pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgi-bhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.
dn33:3.1.102: ‘Aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā khattiya-mahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇa-mahāsālānaṃ vā gahapati-mahāsālānaṃ vā sahavyataṃ uppajjeyyan ti.'
dn33:3.1.103: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ uttariṃ abhāvitaṃ tatr' uppattiyā saṃvattati.
dn33:3.1.104: Tañ ca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa.
dn33:3.1.106: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso idh' ekacco dānaṃ deti Samaṇassa vā Brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandha-vilepanaṃ seyyāvasatha-padīpeyyaṃ.
dn33:3.1.111: ‘Aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjeyyan ti.'

dn33:3.1.143: Ajjhattaṃ rūpa-saññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇa-dubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘Jānāmi passāmīti' evaṃ-saññī hoti.

dn33:3.1.148: Ajjhattaṃ arūpa-saññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇa-dubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘Jānāmi passāmīti' evaṃ-saññī hoti.

dn33:3.1.165: seyyathā pi nāma osadhi-tārakā odātā odāta-vaṇṇā odāta-nidassanā odāta-nibhāsā seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ Bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhato bhāga-vimaṭṭhaṃ odātaṃ odāta-vaṇṇaṃ odāta-nidassanaṃ odāta-nibhāsaṃ
dn33:3.1.166: evam eva ajjhattaṃ arūpa-saññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odāta-nidassanāni odāta-nibhāsāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘Jānāmi passāmīti' evaṃ-saññī hoti.

dn33:3.1.175: Sabbaso rūpa-saññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā, nānatta-saññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘Ananto ākāso' ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.1.177: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘Anantaṃ viññāṇan' ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.1.179: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘N' atthi kiñcīti' ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.1.181: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.1.183: Sabbaso n'evasaññā -nasaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññā-vedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.1.185: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena aṭṭha dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:3.1.186: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṃgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. 2.
dn33:3.2.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena nava dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:3.2.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṃgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:3.2.15: ‘Anattham me acari, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā ti?' āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
dn33:3.2.16: ‘Anattham me carati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā ti?' āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
dn33:3.2.17: ‘Anattham me carissatīti' ‘taṃ kut' ettha labbhā ti?' āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
dn33:3.2.20: anatthaṃ carissatīti' ‘taṃ kut' ettha labbhā ti?' āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
dn33:3.2.23: atthaṃ carissatīti,' ‘taṃ kut' ettha labbhā ti?' āghātaṃ paṭivineti. (iii)
dn33:3.2.25: Sant' āvuso sattā nānatta-kāyā nānatta-saññino seyyathā pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
dn33:3.2.27: Sant' āvuso sattā nānatta-kāyā ekatta-saññino seyyathā pi devā Brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā.
dn33:3.2.29: Sant' āvuso sattā ekatta-kāyā nānatta-saññino seyyathā pi devā Ābhassarā.
dn33:3.2.31: Sant' āvuso sattā ekatta-kāyā ekatta-saññino, seyyathā pi devā Subha-kiṇhā.
dn33:3.2.33: Sant' āvuso sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino seyyathā pi devā Asañña-sattā.
dn33:3.2.35: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso rūpa-saññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭigha-saññānaṃ atthagamā, nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ‘Ananto ākāso ti' ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.37: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti' viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.39: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘N' atthi kiñcīti' ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.41: Sant' āvuso sattā sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.44: Idh' āvuso Tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, Dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodha-gāmī sugata-ppavedito;
dn33:3.2.45: ayañ ca puggalo nirayaṃ uppanno hoti.
dn33:3.2.47: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso Tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, Dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodha-gāmī sugata-ppavedito;
dn33:3.2.48: ayañ ca puggalo tiracchāna-yoniṃ uppanno hoti.
dn33:3.2.60: paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti milakkhusu aviññātāresu yattha n' atthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
dn33:3.2.62: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso Tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, Dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugata-ppavedito, ayañ ca puggalo
dn33:3.2.63: majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti micchā-diṭṭhiko viparīta-dassano --
dn33:3.2.64: ‘N' atthi dinnaṃ, n' atthi yiṭṭhaṃ , n' atthi hutaṃ. n' atthi sukaṭa-dukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, n' atthi ayaṃ loko n' atthi para-loko, n' atthi mātā n' atthi pitā, n' atthi sattā opapātikā, n' atthi loke Samaṇa- brāhmaṇa -sammaggatā sammā-paṭipannā ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.'
dn33:3.2.66: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso Tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, Dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodha-gāmī sugatappavedito; ayañ ca puggalo
dn33:3.2.67: majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo na paṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānaṃ attham aññātuṃ.
dn33:3.2.69: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso Tathāgato ca loke anuppanno hoti arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho,
dn33:3.2.70: Dhammo ca na desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodha-gāmī sugata-ppavedito; ayañ ca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānaṃ attham aññātuṃ.
dn33:3.2.73: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.77: Sabbaso rūpa-saññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭigha-saññānaṃ atthagamā, nānatta-saññānaṃ amanasikārā, ‘Ananto ākāso ti' ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.78: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti' viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.79: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘N' atthi kiñcīti' ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.80: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

dn33:3.2.91: Saññā-vedayita-nirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
dn33:3.2.92: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena nava dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:3.2.93: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 3.
dn33:3.3.1: Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena dasa dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:3.3.2: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgāyitabbaṃ . . . pe . . . atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn33:3.3.5: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti,pātimokkha-saṃvara-saṃvuto viharati, ācāragocara-sampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhaya-dassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn33:3.3.6: Yaṃ p' āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkha-saṃvara-saṃvuto viharati, ācāragocara-sampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhaya-dassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
dn33:3.3.8: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu bahussuto hoti suta-dharo suta-sannicayo. Ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe-kalyāṇā pariyosāna-kalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala- paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathā-rūpassa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
dn33:3.3.9: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu bahussuto hoti . . . pe . . . diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
dn33:3.3.11: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇa-sahāyo kalyāṇa-sampavaṅko.
dn33:3.3.12: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu kalyāṇa-mitto hoti kalyāṇa-sahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko,
dn33:3.3.14: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu subbaco hoti sovacassa-karaṇehi dhammehi samannāgato khamo padakkhiṇa-ggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
dn33:3.3.15: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu subbaco hoti . . . pe . . . padakkhiṇa-ggāhī anusāsaniṃ,
dn33:3.3.17: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṅkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
dn33:3.3.18: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ . . . pe . . . alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ,
dn33:3.3.20: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu dhamma-kāmo hoti piya-samudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷāra-pāmujjo.
dn33:3.3.21: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu dhamma-kāmo hoti . . . pe . . . uḷāra-pāmujjo,
dn33:3.3.23: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītara-cīvara-piṇḍapātasenāsana-gilāna-paccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārehi.
dn33:3.3.24: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti . . . pe . . . parikkhārehi,
dn33:3.3.26: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu āraddha-viriyo viharati, akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷha-parakkamo anikkhitta-dhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
dn33:3.3.27: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati . . . pe . . . anikkhitta-dhuro kusalesu dhammesu,
dn33:3.3.29: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena sati-nepakkena samannāgato cira-katam pi cira-bhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā.
dn33:3.3.30: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu satimā hoti . . . pe . . . saritā anussaritā,
dn33:3.3.32: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayattha-gāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhaya-gāminiyā.
dn33:3.3.33: Yam p' āvuso bhikkhu paññavā hoti . . . pe . . . sammā-dukkhakkhaya-gāminiyā,
dn33:3.3.36: Paṭhavī-kasiṇam eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
dn33:3.3.45: viññāṇa-kasiṇam eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. (iii)
dn33:3.3.47: Pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṃ, kāmesu micchācāro, musā-vādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, vyāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi. (iv)
dn33:3.3.49: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī,musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramanī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramanī, anabhijjhā, avyāpādo, sammā-diṭṭhi. (v)
dn33:3.3.51: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti chaḷaṅga-samannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panunna-pacceka-sacco samavaya-saṭṭhesano anāvila-saṃkappo passaddha-kāya-saṃkhāro suvimuttacitto suvimutta-pañño.
dn33:3.3.52: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti?
dn33:3.3.53: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, vyāpādo pahīno hoti, thīna-middhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti.
dn33:3.3.54: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅga-vippahīno hoti.
dn33:3.3.55: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu chaḷāṅga-samannāgato hoti?
dn33:3.3.56: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno.
dn33:3.3.57: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā. . . . Ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā. . . . Jivhāya rasaṃ sayitvā . . . Kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā. . . .
dn33:3.3.58: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno.
dn33:3.3.59: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
dn33:3.3.60: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti?
dn33:3.3.61: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti.
dn33:3.3.62: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti.
dn33:3.3.63: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu catur-āpasseno hoti?
dn33:3.3.64: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu saṃkhāy' ekaṃ paṭisevati, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ adhivāseti, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ vinodeti, saṃkhāy' ekaṃ parivajjeti.
dn33:3.3.65: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu catur-āpasseno hoti.
dn33:3.3.66: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu panunna-paccekasacco hoti?
dn33:3.3.67: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇa-brāhmaṇānaṃ puthu-pacceka-saccāni sabbāni 'ssa tāni nunnāni honti panunnāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni.
dn33:3.3.68: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu panunna-pacceka-sacco hoti.
dn33:3.3.69: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu samavaya-saṭṭhesano hoti.
dn33:3.3.70: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti, bhavesanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā.
dn33:3.3.71: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
dn33:3.3.72: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu anāvilasaṃkappo hoti?
dn33:3.3.73: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno kāma-saṃkappo pahīno hoti, vyāpāda-saṃkappo pahīno hoti, vihiṃsāsaṃkappo pahīno hoti.
dn33:3.3.74: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu anāvilasaṃkappo hoti.
dn33:3.3.75: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu passaddhakāya-saṃkhāro hoti?
dn33:3.3.76: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkha-m-asukhaṃ upekhāsati-pārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.3.77: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu passaddha-kāya-saṃkhāro hoti.
dn33:3.3.78: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu suvimutta-citto hoti?
dn33:3.3.79: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti.
dn33:3.3.80: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu suvimutta-citto hoti.
dn33:3.3.81: Kathañ c' āvuso bhikkhu suvimutta-pañño hoti?
dn33:3.3.82: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu ‘Rāgo me pahīno ucchinna-mūlo tālā-vatthukato anabhāvaṃ gato āyatiṃ anuppāda-dhammo ti' pajānāti,
dn33:3.3.83: ‘Doso me pahīno ucchinna-mūlo tālā-vatthukato anabhāvaṃ gato āyatiṃ anuppāda-dhammo ti' pajānāti,
dn33:3.3.84: ‘Moho me pahīno ucchinna-mūlo tāla-vatthukato anabhāvaṃ gato āyatiṃ anuppāda-dhammo ti' pajānāti.
dn33:3.3.85: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu suvimutta-pañño hoti. (vi)
dn33:3.3.87: Asekhā sammā-diṭṭhi, asekho sammā-saṃkappo, asekhā sammā-vācā, asekho sammā-kammanto, asekho sammā-ājīvo, asekho sammāvāyāmo, asekhā sammā-sati, asekhā sammā-samādhi, asekhaṃ sammā-ñāṇaṃ, asekhā sammā-vimutti.
dn33:3.3.88: Ime kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena dasa dhammā sammad-akkhātā.
dn33:3.3.89: Tattha sabbeh' eva saṃgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānan ti. 4.
dn33:3.4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi --
dn33:3.4.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ Sāriputta bhikkhūnaṃ Saṃgīti-pariyāyaṃ abhāsīti.'
dn33:3.4.4: Idam avoca āyasmā Sāriputto. Samanuñño Satthā ahosi.
dn33:3.4.5: Attamanā ca te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti.
